en.s: Edward Bruce, earl of Carrick, had landed in Ireland in May the year before, and been proclaimed king of the island in June. Bruce continued on his march south, when on 26 January 1316 the Scottish army was advancing from Castledermot when it encountered the English. The Hiberno-Norman forces, summoned by the justiciar of Ireland, consisted of men such as John FitzThomas FitzGerald, Maurice FitzThomas FitzGerald, Thomas FitzJohn, John and Arnold Poer, Maurice de Rocheford and Miles and David de la Roche. Though these forces heavily outnumbered those of Bruce, internal strife broke out in the Anglo-Irish ranks, a fact that Bruce could take advantage of.

zh.s: 卡里克伯爵爱德华·布鲁斯于前一年5月在爱尔兰登陆，6月被宣布为爱尔兰国王。1316年1月26日，他继续向南推进，苏格兰军队从卡斯尔德莫特出发时遇上英军。爱尔兰司法长官召集的爱尔兰—诺曼军队，成员包括约翰·菲茨托马斯·菲茨杰拉德、莫里斯·菲茨托马斯·菲茨杰拉德、托马斯·菲茨约翰、约翰和阿诺德·波尔、莫里斯·德·罗什福，以及迈尔斯和戴维·德拉罗什。虽然他们兵力远多于布鲁斯，却爆发内部纷争，给了布鲁斯可乘之机。

en.s: The 1531 Lisbon earthquake occurred in the Kingdom of Portugal on the morning of 26 January 1531, between 4 and 5 o'clock. The earthquake and subsequent tsunami resulted in approximately 30,000 deaths. Despite its severity, the disaster was not widely documented until the rediscovery of contemporary records in the early 20th century.

zh.s: 1531年1月26日凌晨4时至5时之间，葡萄牙王国发生里斯本地震。地震及随后的海啸造成约3万人死亡。尽管灾情严重，直到20世纪初，当时的记录重新被发现后，这场灾难才广为人知。

en.s: The Battle of Ula or Battle of Chashniki was fought during the Livonian War on 26 January 1564 between the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Tsardom of Russia on the Ula River (tributary of the Daugava River) north of Chashniki in the Vitebsk Region. The Lithuanian surprise attack resulted in a decisive defeat of the numerically superior Russian forces.

zh.s: 1564年1月26日，利沃尼亚战争中的立陶宛大公国与俄罗斯沙皇国，在维捷布斯克地区恰什尼基以北、道加瓦河支流乌拉河畔交战。立陶宛军突然袭击，彻底击败人数更多的俄军。此战也称恰什尼基战役。

en.t: Pope Pius IV ratifies the Council of Trent decrees
en.s: On 26 January 1564, Pope Pius IV ratified the decrees and definitions of the Council of Trent through the papal bull Benedictus Deus. The council itself had concluded in 1563.

zh.t: 庇护四世批准特伦托会议法令
zh.s: 1564年1月26日，教皇庇护四世通过《Benedictus Deus》诏书，批准特伦托会议的法令和教义规定。会议本身已于1563年结束。

en.s: The Assault on Gullberg Castle (Swedish: Anfallet mot Gullbergs fästning; Danish: Angreb på Gullberg Slot) occurred on 26 January 1612 during the Kalmar War. The female commander of the fortress, Emerentia Krakow, successfully led the Swedish defense after her husband, Mårten Krakow, broke his leg after falling off his horse.

zh.s: 1612年1月26日，卡尔马战争期间，瑞典语称为“古尔贝格要塞突袭”、丹麦语称为“古尔贝格城堡进攻”的战斗爆发。城堡由埃梅伦蒂亚·克拉科夫指挥防守；她的丈夫马尔滕·克拉科夫从马上摔下摔断腿后，她成功率军守住了城堡。

en.s: The Battle of Montjuïc took place on 26 January 1641 during the Reapers' War. A Spanish force under Pedro Fajardo launched an attack on the Catalan army led by Francesc de Tamarit, with French cavalry support. The Spanish force had recently massacred hundreds of rebels who had tried to surrender at Cambrils. The Catalan rebels had taken up position on the heights of Montjuïc which dominated the city of Barcelona.

zh.s: 1641年1月26日，收割者战争期间，西班牙军队在佩德罗·法哈多率领下向弗朗塞斯克·德塔马里特指挥的加泰罗尼亚军队发起进攻，法国骑兵也支援了加泰罗尼亚一方。此前，西班牙军队在坎布里尔斯屠杀了数百名试图投降的起义者。加泰罗尼亚起义军占据了蒙锥克山高地，那里俯瞰巴塞罗那城。

en.s: On 26 January 1658, forces led by Hendrik Carloff captured the Swedish fort of Carolusborg on the Gold Coast, in present-day Ghana.

zh.s: 1658年1月26日，亨德里克·卡洛夫率军攻占瑞典在黄金海岸的卡洛斯堡，地点位于今加纳境内。

en.s: The Treaty of Karlowitz, concluding the Great Turkish War of 1683–1699, in which the Ottoman Empire was defeated by the Holy League at the Battle of Zenta, was signed in Karlowitz (present-day Sremski Karlovci, Serbia), in the Military Frontier of the Habsburg Monarchy, on 26 January 1699. Also known as "The Austrian treaty that saved Europe", it marks the end of Ottoman control in much of Central Europe, with their first major territorial losses in Europe, beginning the reversal of almost three centuries of expansion (1299–1683). The treaty established the Habsburg monarchy as the dominant power of the region.

zh.s: 1699年1月26日，《卡尔洛维茨条约》在哈布斯堡君主国军事边境地区的卡尔洛维茨，今塞尔维亚斯雷姆斯基卡尔洛夫奇，签订，结束1683—1699年大土耳其战争。奥斯曼帝国此前在森塔战役败给神圣同盟。该条约也被称为“拯救欧洲的奥地利条约”，标志着奥斯曼对中欧大部分地区的控制结束，首次在欧洲失去大片领土，并开始逆转1299至1683年间持续扩张的进程。哈布斯堡君主国由此确立地区主导地位。

en.s: The 1700 Cascadia earthquake occurred along the Cascadia subduction zone on January 26, 1700, with an estimated moment magnitude of 8.7–9.2. The megathrust earthquake involved the Juan de Fuca plate from mid-Vancouver Island, south along the Pacific Northwest coast as far as northern California. The plate slipped an average of 20 meters (66 feet) along a fault rupture about 1,000 kilometers (600 miles) long.

zh.s: 1700年1月26日，卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带发生地震，矩震级估计为8.7至9.2级。此次巨大逆冲型地震涉及胡安·德富卡板块，从温哥华岛中部沿太平洋西北海岸一直延伸至加利福尼亚州北部。约1000公里长的断层破裂，板块平均滑动约20米。

en.t: John Byron’s expedition enters and names Port Egmont
en.s: On 26 January 1765, an expedition led by John Byron entered a bay in the Falkland Islands and named it Port Egmont. The expedition went ashore on February 3. The arrival date was January 15 in the Old Style calendar.

zh.t: 约翰·拜伦的探险队抵达并命名埃格蒙特港
zh.s: 1765年1月26日，约翰·拜伦率领的探险队进入福克兰群岛的一处海湾，并将其命名为埃格蒙特港。队伍于2月3日登岸。抵达日期按旧历记为1月15日。

en.s: The Battle of Pachgaon was fought on 26 January 1775 for accession to the throne of the Nagpur Kingdom in central India. Mudhoji Bhonsle killed his brother and rival Sabaji, securing the undisputed regency for Mudhoji's infant son Raghoji II. The battle ended a struggle begun when their brother, the ruler Janoji Bhonsle, died in 1772 after adopting Raghoji II as his heir.

zh.s: 1775年1月26日，印度中部那格浦尔王国为争夺王位爆发帕奇冈战役。穆多吉·邦斯莱杀死其兄弟兼对手萨巴吉，确保自己能为年幼儿子拉戈吉二世担任无争议的摄政。这场斗争始于他们的兄弟、统治者贾诺吉·邦斯莱于1772年去世；贾诺吉此前已收养拉戈吉二世为继承人。

en.s: The Battle of Saint Kitts, also known as the Battle of Frigate Bay, was fought between 25 and 26 January 1782 during the American Revolutionary War between a British fleet under Rear-Admiral of the Blue Sir Samuel Hood and a larger French fleet under François Joseph Paul de Grasse.

zh.s: 圣基茨战役也称弗里盖特湾战役，于1782年1月25日至26日、美国独立战争期间爆发。交战双方是塞缪尔·胡德爵士率领的英国蓝中将舰队，以及弗朗索瓦·约瑟夫·保罗·德格拉斯率领的规模更大的法国舰队。

en.t: First Fleet arrives at Port Jackson
en.s: On 26 January 1788, the British First Fleet arrived at Port Jackson, Australia, after Arthur Phillip rejected Botany Bay as the site for the colony. The arrival marked the beginning of the British colony at Sydney Cove.

zh.t: 英国第一舰队抵达杰克逊港
zh.s: 1788年1月26日，英国第一舰队抵达澳大利亚杰克逊港。阿瑟·菲利普此前放弃在博塔尼湾建立殖民地，转而选择这里，并在悉尼湾开始建立英国殖民地。

en.s: (This article is about the Australian rebellion. For the Mutiny album, see Rum Rebellion (album).) The Rum Rebellion of 1808 was the only successful armed takeover of government in Australian history. During the 19th century, it was widely referred to as the Great Rebellion. The Governor of New South Wales, William Bligh, was deposed by the New South Wales Corps under the command of Major George Johnston, working closely with John Macarthur, on 26 January 1808, 20 years to the day after Arthur Phillip founded European settlement in Australia.

zh.s: 1808年的朗姆酒叛乱，是澳大利亚历史上唯一一次成功以武装手段夺取政府权力的事件，19世纪时广泛称为“大叛乱”。1808年1月26日，乔治·约翰斯顿少校率领的新南威尔士军团，与约翰·麦克阿瑟紧密合作，推翻新南威尔士总督威廉·布莱。当天恰逢亚瑟·菲利普建立澳大利亚欧洲人定居点二十周年。原文还提示，此事件与Mutiny乐队的同名专辑不同。

en.t: French cavalry blocks Badajoz’s northern approach
en.s: On 26 January 1811, Soult sent Latour-Maubourg’s six cavalry battalions across the Guadiana to block the northern approach to Badajoz, Spain. The retained narrative dates the main siege’s commencement to January 27.
en.n: January 26 records the preliminary cavalry blockade. The infobox starts the siege on that date, while the narrative starts it on January 27.

zh.t: 法军骑兵封锁巴达霍斯北部通道
zh.s: 1811年1月26日，苏尔特派拉图尔-莫堡的六个骑兵营渡过瓜迪亚纳河，封锁西班牙巴达霍斯要塞的北部通道。来源正文将主要围城行动的开始记为1月27日。
zh.n: 1月26日记录先行骑兵封锁；资料框将围城开始记为这一天，正文则记为1月27日。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 26 January 1850. Doroteo Vasconcelos, who was the incumbent, ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature. The constitution was amended to allow his reelection.

zh.s: 1850年1月26日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举。现任多罗特奥·巴斯孔塞洛斯没有竞争对手，由立法机关选出连任。宪法为允许他连任而作出修改。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 26 January 1852. Francisco Dueñas ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature. He claimed he was elected with the "unanimous vote of the citizenry". This was the first of four occasions during which Dueñas would serve as the Salvadoran president.

zh.s: 1852年1月26日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举。弗朗西斯科·杜埃尼亚斯没有竞争对手，由立法机关选出。他声称获得“全体公民一致投票”支持。这是杜埃尼亚斯四次担任萨尔瓦多总统中的第一次。

en.s: The Point No Point Treaty was signed on January 26, 1855, at Point No Point, on the northern tip of the Kitsap Peninsula. Governor of Washington Territory, Isaac Stevens, convened the treaty council on January 25, with the S'Klallam, the Chimakum, and the Skokomish tribes. Under the terms of the treaty, the original inhabitants of northern Kitsap Peninsula and Olympic Peninsula ceded ownership of their land in exchange for small reservations along Hood Canal and a payment of $60,000 from the federal government.

zh.s: 波因特诺波因特条约于1855年1月26日在波因特诺波因特签署，地点位于基萨普半岛北端。华盛顿领地总督艾萨克·史蒂文斯于1月25日召集条约会议，参加者包括斯夸克萨姆人、奇马库姆人和斯科科米什人。根据条约，基萨普半岛北部和奥林匹克半岛的原住民放弃土地所有权，换取胡德运河沿岸的小块保留地及联邦政府支付的6万美元。

en.s: The Battle of Seattle was a January 26, 1856 attack by Native Americans upon Seattle, Washington. At the time, Seattle was a settlement in the Washington Territory that had recently named itself after Chief Seattle (Sealth), a leader of the Suquamish and Duwamish peoples of central Puget Sound. Backed by artillery fire and supported by Marines from the United States Navy sloop-of-war Decatur, anchored in Elliott Bay (Seattle's harbor, then called Duwam-sh Bay), the settlers suffered only two deaths. It is not known if any of the Native American raiders died, though the historian Phelps writes that they later "would admit" to 28 dead and 80 wounded.

zh.s: 1856年1月26日，北美原住民袭击华盛顿领地的西雅图定居点。该地刚以普吉特海湾中部苏夸米什人与杜瓦米什人首领西雅图，即Sealth，命名。定居者得到停泊于埃利奥特湾，当时称杜瓦姆什湾，的美国海军战斗帆船“迪凯特”号舰炮及海军陆战队支援，仅两人死亡。原住民袭击者是否有人死亡并不确定，但历史学家菲尔普斯记载，他们后来“承认”28人死亡、80人受伤。

en.s: On January 26, 1861, Louisiana declared its secession from the United States. It was the sixth state to do so, before the outbreak of the Civil War in April.

zh.t: 路易斯安那州宣布脱离联邦
zh.s: 1861年1月26日，路易斯安那州宣布脱离美国联邦，成为第六个宣布脱离联邦的州。美国内战于同年4月爆发。

en.s: On January 26, 1863, Abraham Lincoln appointed Joseph Hooker to command the Union Army of the Potomac in the United States, replacing Ambrose Burnside after the failed Mud March.

zh.t: 约瑟夫·胡克接替安布罗斯·伯恩赛德
zh.s: 1863年1月26日，亚伯拉罕·林肯任命约瑟夫·胡克接替安布罗斯·伯恩赛德，指挥美国联邦军波托马克军团。此前，伯恩赛德发动的“泥泞进军”以失败告终。

loc: 美国阿拉巴马州雅典镇

en.s: The Battle of Athens was fought in Athens, Alabama (Limestone County, Alabama), on January 26, 1864, as part of the American Civil War. The Union force was a company under Captain Emil Adams from the 9th Illinois Mounted Infantry regiment. The Confederate force was the 1st Alabama Cavalry, under Lieutenant Colonel Moses W. Hannon. On the morning of January 26, 1864, at around 4:00 a.m., 600 Confederate cavalrymen attacked Athens, which was being held by a Union force of only 100. Even though the Union defenders had no fortifications and were outnumbered six to one, they were able to repulse the Confederate attack and force them into a retreat after a two-hour battle.

zh.s: 1864年1月26日，美国内战中的雅典镇战役，在阿拉巴马州莱姆斯通县雅典镇展开。联邦军由伊利诺伊第九骑马步兵团的埃米尔·亚当斯上尉率一个连防守，邦联军则为摩西·W.汉农中校指挥的阿拉巴马第一骑兵团。当天凌晨约4时，600名邦联骑兵进攻只有100名联邦军守卫的城镇。守军虽无防御工事、人数处于六比一劣势，仍在两小时战斗后击退敌军，迫其撤退。

en.t: 1881 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1881 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 34th Wisconsin Legislature January 26, 1881. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Angus Cameron did not run for re-election. Republican former U.S. representative Philetus Sawyer was elected United States senator on the first ballot. In the 1881 term, Republicans held overwhelming majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

zh.t: 1881年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1881年1月26日，威斯康星州第三十四届议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党籍现任安格斯·卡梅伦不再参选，共和党籍前联邦众议员菲利特斯·索耶在首轮投票当选。当届共和党在两院均占压倒性多数，有足够票数选出共和党参议员。

en.s: On 26 January 1885, Mahdist forces captured Khartoum, in present-day Sudan, ending a siege that had begun in March 1884. The garrison commander, Charles George Gordon, was killed.

zh.s: 1885年1月26日，马赫迪军攻占今苏丹的喀土穆，结束了自1884年3月开始的围困。守军指挥官查尔斯·乔治·戈登被杀。

en.t: 1887 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1887 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 38th Wisconsin Legislature on January 26, 1887. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Philetus Sawyer was re-elected on the first ballot. At the start of the 1887 term, Republicans held substantial majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

zh.t: 1887年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1887年1月26日，威斯康星州第三十八届议会举行联邦参议员选举，共和党籍现任菲利特斯·索耶在首轮投票获连任。当届议会开始时，共和党在两院均占明显多数，有足够票数选出共和党参议员。

en.s: The Battle of Dogali was fought on 26 January 1887 between Italy and Ethiopia in Dogali near Massawa, in Medri Bahri otherwise known as Eritrea.

zh.s: 多加利战役于1887年1月26日在马萨瓦附近的多加利爆发，交战双方为意大利和埃塞俄比亚。多加利位于梅德里巴赫里地区，也就是今天的厄立特里亚。

en.t: The 3,106-carat (621 g) Cullinan Diamond (pictured), the largest gem-quality rough diamond ever found, was discovered at the Premier Mine in Gauteng, South Africa
en.s: The Cullinan Diamond is the largest gem-quality rough diamond ever found, weighing 3,106 carats (621.20 g), discovered at the Premier No.2 mine in Cullinan, South Africa, on 26 January 1905. It was named after Thomas Cullinan, the owner of the mine. In April 1905, it was put on sale in London, but despite considerable interest, it was still unsold after two years.

zh.t: 库里南钻石在南非豪登省首映矿场被发现
zh.s: 库里南钻石是迄今发现的最大宝石级原钻，重3106克拉（621.20克）。它于1905年1月26日在南非库里南的Premier 2号矿场被发现，以矿主托马斯·库里南的名字命名。1905年4月，这颗钻石在伦敦挂牌出售；尽管受到广泛关注，两年后仍未售出。

en.s: The siege of Mbombwe started on 25 January 1915 when soldiers of the Government of Nyasaland attacked the rebel capital of Mbombwe. The siege ended on the next day when troops from the King's African Rifles stormed the rebel capital after a fierce fight with the rebels.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1915年1月25日，尼亚萨兰政府军袭击叛军首都姆邦布韦，围城战由此开始。次日，国王非洲步枪团的士兵在与叛军激战后攻入该城，围城战结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On January 26, 1915, Rocky Mountain National Park was established in Colorado, United States.

zh.s: 1915年1月26日，落基山国家公园在美国科罗拉多州成立。

en.t: Red lantern signals an uprising in Helsinki
en.s: On 26 January 1918, a red lantern was lit in the tower of Helsinki Workers’ Hall in Finland as a signal of revolution. The mobilisation and fighting of the Finnish Civil War unfolded over the following days.

zh.t: 赫尔辛基工人会堂亮起起义信号
zh.s: 1918年1月26日，芬兰赫尔辛基工人会堂塔楼亮起红灯，发出革命信号。芬兰内战的动员和战斗在随后几天展开。

en.t: 1918 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final played
en.s: On 26 January 1919, the final of the 1918 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship was played at Croke Park in Dublin, Ireland. Limerick defeated Wexford.

zh.t: 1918年全爱尔兰高级组爱尔兰式曲棍球决赛举行
zh.s: 1919年1月26日，1918年全爱尔兰高级组爱尔兰式曲棍球锦标赛决赛在爱尔兰都柏林的克罗克公园举行，利默里克队战胜韦克斯福德队。

en.s: The retained source dates the Second Italo-Senussi War in Libya from 26 January 1923 to 24 January 1932. Italian colonial forces fought resistance associated with the Senussi order.

zh.t: 第二次意大利—塞努西战争开始
zh.s: 来源将利比亚的第二次意大利—塞努西战争记为1923年1月26日至1932年1月24日。意大利殖民军与塞努西教团相关的抵抗力量交战。

en.s: On 26 January 1924, shortly after Vladimir Lenin’s death, Petrograd, in present-day Russia, was renamed Leningrad.

zh.s: 1924年1月26日，列宁去世后不久，今俄罗斯的彼得格勒改名为列宁格勒。

en.s: On 26 January 1930, people across India observed Independence Day following the Indian National Congress’s call for complete independence. This was a campaign observance under British rule; India became independent in 1947.

zh.t: 印度各地举行独立日活动
zh.s: 1930年1月26日，响应印度国民大会党要求完全独立的号召，印度各地举行独立日活动。当时印度仍在英国统治下，直到1947年才正式独立。

en.s: The First Battle of Nanawa was fought from 20 to 26 January 1933 between the Bolivian and Paraguayan armies during the Chaco War. Nanawa (Enxet for "carob tree forest"), established by the Paraguayans in 1928, was considered the strongest Paraguayan outpost after it was heavily fortified by the end of 1932 under directives of Ivan Belaieff and Nicolas Ern, two White Russian former officers who joined the Paraguayan army in the 1920s.

Both countries pledged to resolve their problems by bilateral negotiations and to forgo armed conflict for a period of 10 years.

zh.s: 《德波互不侵犯宣言》又称《德波互不侵犯条约》，由纳粹德国与波兰第二共和国于1934年1月26日在柏林签署。两国承诺通过双边谈判解决分歧，并在十年内不发生武装冲突。

en.s: The fall of Barcelona was the capture of Barcelona, until then in the Republican zone, by the Nationalists; it took place on 26 January 1939, during the final phases of the Spanish Civil War. The event was part of the Catalan Offensive, which took the Catalan enclave of the Republic.

zh.s: 1939年1月26日，西班牙内战接近尾声时，国民军攻占了此前属于共和国控制区的巴塞罗那。这是加泰罗尼亚攻势的一部分，该攻势夺取了共和国在加泰罗尼亚的控制区。

en.s: The Catalonia Offensive (Catalan: Ofensiva de Catalunya, Spanish: Ofensiva de Cataluña) was part of the Spanish Civil War. The Nationalist Army started the offensive on 23 December 1938 and rapidly conquered Republican-held Catalonia with Barcelona (the Republic's capital city from October 1937). Barcelona was captured on 26 January 1939. The Republican and Catalan governments headed for the French border.
en.n: Spanish Civil War: Catalonia Offensive: Troops loyal to nationalist General Francisco Franco and aided by Italy take Barcelona.

zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚攻势是西班牙内战的一部分。民族主义军队于1938年12月23日发起攻势，迅速攻占由共和派控制的加泰罗尼亚地区。巴塞罗那自1937年10月起是共和国首都，于1939年1月26日被攻占。共和政府和加泰罗尼亚政府随后向法国边境撤退。
zh.n: 西班牙内战：加泰罗尼亚攻势：效忠民族主义派将领弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥的部队在意大利协助下攻占巴塞罗那。

en.t: US 34th Infantry Division troops land in Belfast
en.s: On January 26, 1942, soldiers of the US Army’s 34th Infantry Division landed in Belfast, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom, as American combat forces began arriving in the British Isles during World War II.

zh.t: 美军第34步兵师士兵在贝尔法斯特登陆
zh.s: 1942年1月26日，美军第34步兵师的士兵在英国北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特登陆，成为二战期间开始抵达不列颠群岛的美国作战部队。

en.t: Audie Murphy holds off a German attack near Holtzwihr
en.s: On January 26, 1945, Audie Murphy helped repel a German attack near Holtzwihr, France. He covered his company’s withdrawal and fired from a burning tank destroyer before leading a counterattack. He later received the Medal of Honor for his actions.

zh.t: 奥迪·墨菲在霍尔茨维尔附近阻击德军
zh.s: 1945年1月26日，奥迪·墨菲在法国霍尔茨维尔附近抵挡德军进攻。他掩护所在连队撤退，在一辆燃烧的坦克歼击车上开火，随后率队反击。他后来因此获得荣誉勋章。

en.s: The 1947 KLM Douglas DC-3 crash refers to the crash of a KLM Royal Dutch Airlines flight from Amsterdam to Stockholm via Copenhagen on 26 January. It occurred shortly after the Douglas DC-3 took off from Kastrup Airport in Denmark. All 16 passengers and 6 crew members on board were killed.

zh.t: 1947年荷兰皇家航空道格拉斯DC-3空难
zh.s: 1947年荷兰皇家航空道格拉斯DC-3空难，指一架荷航客机于1月26日从阿姆斯特丹经哥本哈根飞往斯德哥尔摩途中坠毁。飞机从丹麦卡斯特鲁普机场起飞后不久便发生事故，机上16名乘客和6名机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: Constitution of India comes into force
en.s: On 26 January 1950, the Constitution of India came into force, and India became a republic. The date is observed as Republic Day.

en.t: Office of President of India established
en.s: On 26 January 1950, the office of President of India was created as the constitution came into force and India became a republic.

zh.s: 1950年1月26日，印度宪法生效，印度成为共和国，同时设立总统职位。

en.s: The Cairo Fire (Arabic: حريق القاهرة), also known as Black Saturday, was a series of riots that took place on 26 January 1952, marked by the burning and looting of some 750 buildings—retail shops, cafes, cinemas, hotels, restaurants, theatres, nightclubs, and the city's Casino Opera —in downtown Cairo.

zh.s: 开罗大火（阿拉伯语：حريق القاهرة）也称“黑色星期六”，是1952年1月26日发生的一系列骚乱。市中心约750座建筑遭焚烧或洗劫，包括商店、咖啡馆、电影院、酒店、餐馆、剧院、夜总会和歌剧赌场。

en.s: Operation Cedar Falls was a military operation of the Vietnam War conducted primarily by US forces that took place from 8 to 26 January 1967. The aim of the massive search-and-destroy operation was to eradicate the Iron Triangle, an area northwest of Saigon that had become a major stronghold of the Viet Cong (VC).

en.t: JAT Flight 367 is destroyed by a terrorist bomb, killing 27 of the 28 people on board the DC-9. Flight attendant Vesna Vulović survives with critical injuries
en.s: JAT Flight 367 was a McDonnell Douglas DC-9-32 aircraft (registration YU-AHT) which exploded shortly after overflying NDB Hermsdorf (located in or around Hinterhermsdorf, in the present-day municipality of Sebnitz), Germany, while en route from Stockholm, Sweden, to Belgrade, SFR Yugoslavia, on 26 January 1972. The aircraft, piloted by Captain Ludvik Razdrih and First Officer Ratko Mihić, broke into three pieces and spun out of control, crashing near the village of Srbská Kamenice in Czechoslovakia (now the Czech Republic).

zh.t: 南斯拉夫航空367号班机遭炸弹袭击，机上28人中27人遇难；空乘维斯娜·武洛维奇重伤生还
zh.s: 1972年1月26日，南斯拉夫航空367号班机从瑞典斯德哥尔摩飞往南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国贝尔格莱德途中，在飞越德国赫姆斯多夫无方向信标台后不久发生爆炸。飞机为麦道DC-9-32型，注册编号YU-AHT，由机长卢德维克·拉兹德里赫和副驾驶拉特科·米希奇驾驶。飞机断成三截，失控后坠毁在当时捷克斯洛伐克境内的斯尔布斯卡卡梅尼采村附近（今属捷克）。

en.s: Turkish Airlines Flight 301 was a passenger flight operated by a Fokker F28-1000 Fellowship of Turkish Airlines that crashed during takeoff at İzmir Cumaovası Airport on 26 January 1974 while en route to Istanbul Yeşilköy Airport, killing 67 of its 73 passengers and crew. The aircraft spent the night prior to the accident outside in freezing temperatures, causing frost accumulation on the wings, which was unnoticed by the crew before departure.

zh.t: 土耳其航空301号班机空难
zh.s: 土耳其航空301号班机由一架福克F28-1000“友谊”客机执飞，1974年1月26日在伊兹密尔朱马奥瓦瑟机场起飞时坠毁，当时正飞往伊斯坦布尔耶希尔科伊机场。机上73名乘客和机组人员中有67人遇难。事故前一晚，飞机停在室外，低温导致机翼结霜；机组人员起飞前没有发现结冰。

en.s: General elections were held in Gibraltar on 26 January 1984. The AACR administration of Sir Joshua Hassan was elected for a further term. The election was called the dockyard election, as the future of the Gibraltar Royal Naval Dockyard was the only significant campaign issue.

zh.s: 1984年1月26日，直布罗陀举行大选，约书亚·哈桑爵士领导的促进公民权利协会政府获选连任。这次被称为“船坞选举”，因为直布罗陀皇家海军船坞的前途，是唯一重要的竞选议题。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 26 January 1986, with a second round on 16 February. This was closest presidential election ever held in Portugal and was won by the Socialist Mário Soares, who initially had no more than 8 percent in opinion polls. The first round was easily won by Freitas do Amaral, supported by all the right-wing parties, with 46% of the votes.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1986年1月26日举行总统选举，第二轮投票在2月16日举行。这是葡萄牙历来竞争最接近的一次总统选举。社会党人马里奥·苏亚雷斯最终获胜，尽管他起初在民调中的支持率不超过8%。得到所有右翼政党支持的弗雷塔斯·多阿马拉尔以46%的得票率，在第一轮投票中明显领先。

en.s: The Battle of Kampala was a battle of the Ugandan Bush War that took place from 17 to 26 January 1986 in which forces of the National Resistance Army (NRA) attacked and captured the Ugandan capital, Kampala, from the Uganda National Liberation Army (UNLA). As a result, the Ugandan government was deposed and replaced by a new one under NRA leader Yoweri Museveni.

zh.s: 乌干达丛林战争期间，国家抵抗军于1986年1月17日至26日进攻并攻占首都坎帕拉，夺取乌干达民族解放军控制的城市。此后乌干达政府被推翻，由国家抵抗军领导人约韦里·穆塞韦尼组建新政府。

en.s: Operation Typhoon was a combined-arms military operation carried out by the Soviet Armed Forces and the Afghan Armed Forces from January 23 to 26, 1989. It was one of the last major military operation conducted by Soviet forces during the Soviet–Afghan War. It targeted Ahmad Shah Massoud's ethnic Tajik mujahideen fighters in in the provinces of Parwan, Baghlan, and Kunduz with the aim of "causing as much damage as possible to the opposition forces in the central and northern provinces of the country".

zh.s: 1991年1月26日，西亚德·巴雷在索马里的总统任期结束。他自1969年10月通过军事政变上台后一直掌权。

en.s: The 1992 African Cup of Nations final was a football match that took place on 26 January 1992, at the Stade de l'Amitié in Dakar, Senegal, to determine the winner of the 1992 African Cup of Nations. Ivory Coast defeated Ghana 11–10 on penalties after a goalless draw to win their first African Cup. The penalty shootout was the first time that every player on the field took a penalty in a major international final.

zh.s: 1992年非洲国家杯决赛于1月26日在塞内加尔达喀尔友谊体育场举行。科特迪瓦与加纳在比赛中互交白卷，随后科特迪瓦在点球大战中以11比10获胜，首次夺得非洲国家杯冠军。这是重大国际赛事决赛中，首次出现双方场上所有球员都主罚点球的情况。

en.s: The 1997 European Challenge Cup Final was the final match of the 1996–97 European Challenge Cup, the inaugural season of Europe's second-tier club rugby union competition. The match was played on 26 January 1997 at Stade de la Méditerranée in Béziers. The match was contested by Bourgoin and Castres Olympique, who are both from France. Bourgoin won the match 18–9; with match conceding no tries by either team.

zh.s: 1997年欧洲挑战杯决赛是1996—1997赛季欧洲挑战杯的决赛，也是欧洲第二级别俱乐部橄榄球赛事的首届决赛。比赛于1997年1月26日在法国贝济耶的地中海体育场举行，由法国布尔关队对阵卡斯特尔奥林匹克队。布尔关以18比9获胜，双方均未达阵得分。

en.t: An earthquake in the Indian state of Gujarat killed at least 20,000 people, injured 167,000 others and destroyed nearly 400,000 homes
en.s: An earthquake struck India and Pakistan on 26 January 2001 at 08:46 am IST. The epicentre was about 9 km south-southwest of the village of Chobari in Bhachau Taluka of Kutch district in Gujarat, India. The earthquake had a maximum Mercalli intensity of XII (Extreme). The intraplate earthquake measured 7.6 on the moment magnitude scale and occurred at a depth of 17.4 km (10.8 mi).

zh.t: 印度古吉拉特邦地震造成至少2万人死亡、16.7万人受伤，近40万所房屋被毁
zh.s: 2001年1月26日上午8时46分（印度标准时间），印度和巴基斯坦发生地震。震中位于印度古吉拉特邦库奇县巴乔塔卢卡的乔巴里村以南偏西约9公里处。地震矩震级为7.6级，震源深度17.4公里，最高烈度达麦加利烈度XII级（极强）。

zh.t: 2008年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选于1月26日举行。伊利诺伊州参议员贝拉克·奥巴马以领先28.9个百分点的优势赢得选民投票。对2008年的两大党而言，南卡罗来纳州都是首个举行初选的南部州，也是首个非裔美国人在选民中占有相当比例的初选州。

en.s: The 2009 Malagasy political crisis began on 26 January 2009 with the political opposition movement led by Antananarivo mayor Andry Rajoelina, which sought to oust President Marc Ravalomanana from the presidency. The crisis reached its climax in the 2009 Malagasy coup d'état led by Colonel Noël Rakotonandrasana when Andry Rajoelina was declared the president of the High Transitional Authority of Madagascar on 21 March 2009, five days after Ravalomanana transferred his power to a military council and fled to South Africa.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Sri Lanka on 26 January 2010. They were the sixth presidential elections held in the country's history, and the first to be held following the conclusion of the Sri Lankan civil war. Incumbent president Mahinda Rajapaksa of the governing United People's Freedom Alliance was re-elected with 57.88% of the vote, defeating his main opponent Sarath Fonseka of the New Democratic Front, an opposition coalition backed by the United National Party.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2010年1月26日举行总统选举。这是该国历史上第六次总统选举，也是斯里兰卡内战结束后的首次总统选举。执政联盟统一人民自由联盟的现任总统马欣达·拉贾帕克萨获得57.88%的选票，击败主要对手萨拉特·丰塞卡，成功连任。丰塞卡代表由统一国民党支持的反对派联盟新民主阵线参选。

en.t: 2012 Papua New Guinea Defence Force mutiny
en.s: The 2012 Papua New Guinea Defence Force mutiny took place on 26 January 2012 when a group of military personnel headed by retired Colonel Yaura Sasa took the commander of the defence force, Brigadier General Francis Agwi, prisoner. The mutiny was related to a dispute over the prime ministership between Sir Michael Somare and Peter O'Neill which had begun in December 2011 when the Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea ordered that Somare be reinstated as the prime minister while the country's parliament supported O'Neill. Following the crisis in December, Somare directed Governor-General Sir Michael Ogio to appoint Sasa as the commander of the Papua New Guinea Defence Force (PNGDF).

zh.t: 2012年巴布亚新几内亚国防军兵变

en.s: A by-election for the Punggol East Single Member Constituency in Singapore was held on 26 January 2013 because of the resignation of former parliamentary speaker Michael Palmer from the People's Action Party on 12 December 2012. This was the 17th by-election since the first election, and the second by-election in as many years. The Nomination Day was held on 16 January 2013, while Polling Day was on 26 January 2013. This was also returning officer, Yam Ah Mee's last stint, following his resignation from the People's Association. On 26 January 2013, Lee Li Lian of the Workers' Party elected as the Member of Parliament for Punggol East SMC.

en.s: Royal Rumble (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE and presented by Jackson Hewitt which took place on January 26, 2014 at the Consol Energy Center in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It was the twenty-seventh annual Royal Rumble and the first WWE pay-per-view in 2014. It was the first WWE pay-per-view event in Pittsburgh since the 2009 Bragging Rights event, and the first pay-per-view event at Consol Energy Center since it opened in 2010. Five matches (including the pre-show) took place at the event.

zh.s: 2014年1月26日，WWE在美国宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的康索尔能源中心，举办第27届年度“皇家大战”按次付费职业摔角赛，由Jackson Hewitt冠名呈现。这是WWE当年首场按次付费赛事，也是2009年“Bragging Rights”之后首次在匹兹堡举行，以及该中心2010年启用后首次承办按次付费赛事。连同赛前节目，共进行了五场比赛。

Iraq defeated the Saudis thanks to a 33rd minute goal from Mohannad Abdul-Raheem and took their first Asian title at U-22 level.

Thirty-three others, all on the ground, were injured.

en.s: The 2018 Supercopa Uruguaya was the first edition of the Supercopa Uruguaya, Uruguay's football super cup. It was held on 26 January 2018 between 2017 Torneo Intermedio winners Nacional and 2017 Primera División champions Peñarol. It was originally scheduled to be played on 28 January, however, and due to Nacional's first match in the 2018 Copa Libertadores being scheduled on 31 January, the Supercopa was moved to 26 January.

en.t: Seiji Mataichi elected Japan’s Social Democratic Party leader unopposed
en.s: On 26 January 2018, Seiji Mataichi was elected leader of Japan’s Social Democratic Party without a vote after no other candidate registered. The scheduled February 10–11 ballot was unnecessary; he formally took office at the party convention on February 25.
en.n: This records the unopposed selection on January 26, not the planned February 10–11 vote or the February 25 inauguration.

en.s: On January 26, 2020, a Sikorsky S-76B helicopter crashed into a hillside in the city of Calabasas, California around 25 mi (40 km) northwest of downtown Los Angeles, while en route from John Wayne Airport to Camarillo Airport. All nine people on board were killed: former professional basketball player Kobe Bryant and his 13-year-old daughter Gianna; baseball coach John Altobelli, his wife Keri and their 14-year-old daughter Alyssa; Sarah Chester and her 13-year-old daughter Payton; basketball coach Christina Mauser and the pilot Ara Zobayan.

en.s: On 26 January 2022, the Venezuelan opposition promoted a recall referendum against the Nicolás Maduro government. The National Electoral Council ordered the collection of the required signatures, 20% of the electoral registry, to be carried out in a single day, the equivalent of having to collect four million signatures in twelve hours, which resulted in not reaching the required signatures, the referendum being declared inadmissible and making it impossible to summon for another recall for Maduro's second presidential term.

zh.t: 2022年委内瑞拉总统罢免公投倡议
zh.s: 2022年1月26日，委内瑞拉反对派推动针对尼古拉斯·马杜罗政府的罢免公投。全国选举委员会要求在一天内收集相当于登记选民20%的签名，即在12小时内收集400万个签名。最终签名数量未达要求，公投申请被裁定不予受理，也使反对派无法在马杜罗第二个总统任期内再次发起罢免公投。

en.s: National Assembly elections were held in Nepal on 26 January 2022 in order to elect 19 of the 20 retiring Class II members of the National Assembly, the upper house of the Federal Parliament of Nepal. Members of the National Assembly are elected through indirect ballot and serve six year terms with one third of the members retiring every two years.

en.s: The 51st International Film Festival Rotterdam, is the 2022 edition of the International Film Festival Rotterdam, which took place online from 26 January 2022 to 6 February 2022. zh.s: 第51届鹿特丹国际电影节是2022年举行的一届电影节，于2022年1月26日至2月6日在线举办。由于奥密克戎变异株在欧洲传播，这已是电影节连续第二年在线举行。电影节以阿曼达·克莱默执导的《请宝贝，请》开幕。

en.s: General elections were held in Tuvalu on 26 January 2024. There are no political parties in Tuvalu and all candidates run as independents. Two major issues in the election were the Falepili Union treaty, which requiries both Tuvalu and Australia to "mutually agree" Tuvalu's foreign security arrangements in exchange for allowing Tuvaluans displaced by climate change to immigrate to Australia, and the country's diplomatic recognition of Taiwan within the context of great power competition between the United States and China for influence in the region.

zh.s: 图瓦卢于2024年1月26日举行大选。该国没有政党，所有候选人均以独立身份参选。选举的两大议题，一是《法莱皮利联盟条约》：澳大利亚允许受气候变化影响而流离失所的图瓦卢人移居，作为交换，图瓦卢的对外安全安排须由两国共同同意；二是在中美争夺地区影响力的背景下，图瓦卢是否继续承认台湾的外交地位。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Belarus on 26 January 2025. The president is directly elected to serve a five-year term. Incumbent president Alexander Lukashenko has won every presidential election since 1994, with all but the first being deemed by international monitors as neither free nor fair. Prior to the elections, independent media was closed down or forced to operate from abroad.

zh.s: 白俄罗斯于2025年1月26日举行总统选举。总统由选民直接选举产生，任期五年。现任总统亚历山大·卢卡申科自1994年以来赢得了每一次总统选举；国际观察员认为，除首次选举外，其余选举均不自由，也不公平。选举前，独立媒体遭到关闭，或被迫迁往境外运作。

en.s: The 2025 Supercopa Uruguaya, officially named 2025 Supercopa Uruguaya – 250 Años de la Ciudad de Rosario, was the eighth edition of the Supercopa Uruguaya, Uruguay's football super cup. It was held on 26 January 2025 between the 2024 Primera División champions Peñarol and the 2024 Torneo Intermedio winners Nacional at Estadio Centenario in Montevideo. In the match, Nacional defeated Peñarol 2–1 to win their third Supercopa Uruguaya title.

zh.s: 2025年乌拉圭超级杯是第八届乌拉圭超级杯，正式名称为“2025年乌拉圭超级杯——罗萨里奥建城250周年”。比赛于2025年1月26日在蒙得维的亚世纪球场举行，对阵双方是2024年甲级联赛冠军佩纳罗尔队和2024年中间锦标赛冠军民族队。民族队以2比1击败佩纳罗尔，第三次夺得超级杯冠军。
